overview: A professional, full-featured church youth ministry website with animated homepage, member portal, admin dashboard, event booking, media library, sermons, blog, gallery, prayer requests, testimonials, and online donations — built for youth engagement and community growth.
features: Animated homepage with church branding, scripture, announcements, and upcoming events
Member registration/login with role-based access (Admin, Leader, Member)
Admin dashboard for managing events, content, users, donations, and analytics
Media library with video, audio, PDF, and image upload/download via cloud storage
Events system with RSVP booking and attendee management
Sermons, Devotionals, and Blog sections with rich text editor
Gallery with organized albums and lightbox view
Testimonials and About Us/Leadership Team pages
Online donations via Stripe with receipt emails
Contact page with form, social media links, and WhatsApp support
